title: It's Not About The Nail
summary: A two-minute comedy sketch in which a woman describes her problems while a visible nail sticks out of her head, and her partner keeps trying to fix it instead of listening. It dramatizes the gap between wanting empathy and being offered solutions.
why: HN commenters link it as the quickest memorable illustration of listening versus problem-solving, and as shorthand in threads on empathy and support.

quote.text: This was the single most impactful thing I've ever been told to watch when it comes to 'solving' vs 'listening'.
